summary: From fiscal 2021 to 2026, Atlassian Corporation reported $24.6 billion of revenue and $6.5 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $5.9 billion, which leaves $637 million of owner cash: 2.6% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 3 of 6 years.
